_doc: Per-brand overrides for the ntn engine. Keys are lowercase brand names and OVERRIDE built-in behavior. Fields (all optional): paging = pager-disabling command ("" = none); secret_cmd = privilege command ("" = none); config_enter / config_leave = enter/leave config mode; save_lines = array of lines sent after the script ([] = no save); save_delay = seconds per save line; config_show = full config pull command; hostname_show = hostname pull command; hostname_field = hostname|sysname|host-name|colon; err_pattern = grep -E pattern for device errors; negate_prefix = rollback_gen negation prefix without trailing space (no|undo|delete|...). Built-in brands: cisco, huawei, aruba, arista, ruijie, juniper, mikrotik, fortinet. Unknown brands without a profile get generic Cisco-like defaults and skip the save step (running-config only).

zte._doc: EXAMPLE profile — ZXR10 is Cisco-like; adjust to your ZTE model/firmware.
